Some bots misbehave: they flood rooms, or their webhooks keep failing.

> As an administrator, I want misbehaving bots to be stopped automatically,
> and I want to decide when they come back.

Flooding:

- A bot may post at most 10 messages in any 10 seconds. Messages posted through the API and webhook replies both count.
- The message that goes over the limit is rejected and starts a 30-second cooldown. During the cooldown, the posting endpoint responds with `429 Too Many Requests` and a `Retry-After` header (seconds left), and webhook replies are not posted.
- Five more attempts to post during the same cooldown suspend the bot.

Failing webhooks:

- A failed delivery is any response other than `2xx`, a timeout, or a connection error.
- Ten failed deliveries in a row suspend the bot. A successful delivery resets the count.

A suspended bot:

- gets `403 Forbidden` from the posting endpoint;
- receives no webhooks;
- keeps its rooms and messages, and still counts towards its owner's bot limit;
- stays listed on the bots page and shows as "Suspended", with the reason.

Only administrators can reactivate a suspended bot, from the bots page: a "Reactivate" button that asks for confirmation. The limits above are fixed in code; they have no settings.

## Bot Moderation (Flooding, Failing Webhooks, Suspension & Reactivation)
- Moderation state lives on `users` (`suspended_at`, `suspension_reason`, `cooldown_until`, `cooldown_attempts`, `consecutive_webhook_failures`, `flood_reset_message_id`), keeping `status: :active` so suspended bots retain rooms/messages, still count toward `bot_limit_reached?`, stay listed on `/bots`, and remain editable/deletable by creators and admins.
- `User::Bot#post_message_with_rate_limit` wraps message creation in `with_lock` (SQLite immediate transaction) so API posts (`Bots::MessagesController#create`) and synchronous webhook replies (`User::Bot::Webhook#handle_response`) share one atomic 10-messages-in-10-seconds sliding window (`messages` indexed on `[:creator_id, :created_at]`).

- `User::Bot#record_webhook_delivery!` tracks `consecutive_webhook_failures`: any non-`2xx` response, timeout, or connection error increments the counter (suspending at 10 with `WEBHOOK_SUSPENSION_REASON`), while any `2xx` response resets it to `0`.
- Suspended bots receive `403 Forbidden` from `Bots::MessagesController` (`ensure_not_suspended` before `set_room`) and receive no webhooks (`Message::Mentionee#mentioned_bots`, `Room#deliver_joined_webhooks_later`, `User::Bot#deliver_*_webhook_later`, and `User::Bot::Webhook#deliverable?` all skip suspended bots).
- `/bots` (`app/views/bots/_bot.html.erb`) displays `"Suspended"` and `bot.suspension_reason` to both owners and administrators, and renders a `"Reactivate"` button (`POST /bots/:bot_id/reactivation`, `Bots::ReactivationsController#create` guarded by `ensure_can_administer`) with `data-turbo-confirm` solely for administrators.
- `User::Bot#reactivate` clears suspension/cooldown/webhook failure counters and records `flood_reset_message_id` so the reactivated bot can post immediately without pre-suspension messages counting against the 10-second window.
